m_smooth.speaker: ryan
m_smooth.instruct: Confident, upbeat narrator with a steady, level pitch and a relaxed low voice. Speaks fast in one smooth, continuous flow, words linking naturally. Engaging but not hyped, no big rises in pitch, no long pauses.
m_smooth.note: Best long-form male. Record long scripts line by line with reel_vo.py --f0 130-165.

m_excited.speaker: ryan
m_excited.instruct: Very excited, upbeat and fast-paced, like a hyped creator sharing a discovery. Bright, smiling, smooth and confident, speaking quickly with no long pauses.
